title: auto-delete only removes tasks captured in a previous commit
description: AutoClean now gates deletion on the task's ID being present in HEAD's committed version of the tasks file (new Store.committedIDs helper, passed git into AutoClean). A closed task that was never committed is left untouched, since deleting it would lose work that git history cannot recover (md get from history relies on the task existing in some commit). Same-session add+close tasks now persist one commit cycle before cleanup. The --disable flag already existed (uninstalls the pre-commit hook); no change needed there.
